body:
Media Alert - Brisk Sale of Creative Prodikeys DM at the 3rd Creativex Warehouse Sale raises $40,000 for Charity

Charity Proceeds

As of 6pm Sunday, a total of about 2,000 units of the newly launched Prodikeys DM was sold during the 4-day sale. This is equivalent to one Prodikeys DM sold every 58-seconds. Mr. Sim Wong Hoo, Creative Technology's Chairman and CEO will therefore donate $40,000 to The Straits Times School Pocket Money Fund fulfilling his promise to donate $20 for every Prodikeys DM sold.

"I am ecstatic about the sell-through of this newly launched Prodikeys DM. By all measures, this breaks the records of all the past products we have ever sold. In fact, I am even more impressed by the sale at the Tampines Changkat Sunday Market, which far exceeded our expectation as we did not anticipate the overwhelming response from the heartlanders." said Mr. Sim.
